title: Sandthief's Ring
summary: Inaccessible ring grants Invisibility once per Long Rest.

fields.Invisibility: Action, touch, Concentration up to 10 turns. The target becomes Invisible until it attacks, casts, or takes a revealing action. The item labels this level 1 while the general spell is level 2.
fields.Base value: 40 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
